Key.Japanese: 1. 地政学的背景（カルテル戦争）
Key.Chinese: 1. 地缘政治背景（卡特尔战争）

Key.Original:
1. Global Context (War Against the Tanoa Mafia)

The Tanoa archipelago has fallen under the grip of a heavily armed mafia and narco-terrorist syndicate. This cartel controls drug refining, maritime smuggling, and heavy weapons trafficking, becoming a major international danger to global security.

The RACS Foreign Legion (French Branch)
With local forces crippled by corruption and outgunned, Allied High Command has deployed the French branch of the RACS Foreign Legion.

This elite force of seasoned operators and international volunteers is tasked with striking without delay to crush this criminal syndicate, eliminate its kingpins, and restore security across the archipelago.
Key.French:
1. Contexte Global (Guerre contre la Mafia de Tanoa)

L'archipel de Tanoa est tombé sous la coupe d'une organisation mafieuse et narco-terroriste surarmée. Ce cartel contrôle le raffinage des stupéfiants, la contrebande maritime et le trafic d'armes lourdes, devenant un danger international majeur pour la sécurité mondiale.

La Légion Étrangère du RACS (Branche Française)
Face à la corruption et à l'impuissance des forces locales, le commandement allié a déployé la branche française de la Légion Étrangère du RACS.

Cette force d'élite d'opérateurs chevronnés et volontaires internationaux a reçu l'ordre d'intervenir sans délai pour anéantir ce syndicat criminel, éliminer ses barons et restaurer la sécurité dans l'archipel.

Key.Spanish:
1. Contexto Global (Guerra contra la Mafia de Tanoa)

El archipiélago de Tanoa ha caído bajo el control de una organización mafiosa y narcoterrorista fuertemente armada. Este cartel controla el refinado de drogas y el tráfico marítimo de armas, convirtiéndose en un peligro internacional grave para la seguridad global.

La Legión Extranjera de RACS (Rama Francesa)
Ante la impotencia de las fuerzas locales, el Alto Mando ha desplegado la rama francesa de la Legión Extranjera de RACS.

Esta fuerza de élite tiene la misión de aplastar a este sindicato criminal, eliminar a sus cabecillas y restablecer la paz en el archipiélago.
Key.Italian:
1. Contesto Globale (Guerra contro la Mafia di Tanoa)

L'arcipelago di Tanoa è caduto sotto il controllo di un sindacato mafioso e narcoterrorista pesantemente armato. Questo cartello controlla il traffico marittimo e di armi, diventando un grave pericolo internazionale.

La Legione Straniera RACS (Branca Francese)
Di fronte alla corruzione locale, il Comando ha schierato la branca francese della Legione Straniera RACS per neutralizzare i boss e smantellare i loro santuari.
Key.German:
1. Globaler Kontext (Krieg gegen die Tanoa-Mafia)

Der Tanoa-Archipel ist unter die Kontrolle eines schwer bewaffneten Mafia- und Drogenterrorismus-Kartells geraten. Dieses Kartell kontrolliert Raffinerien und Waffenschmuggel und ist zu einer internationalen Gefahr geworden.

Die RACS-Fremdenlegion (Französischer Zweig)
Da die lokalen Behörden überfordert sind, entsendet das Oberkommando die französische Abteilung der RACS-Fremdenlegion, um das Syndikat zu zerschlagen und die Anführer zu eliminieren.
Key.Polish:
1. Kontekst Globalny (Wojna z mafią Tanoa)

Archipelag Tanoa dostał się pod kontrolę uzbrojonego syndykatu mafijnego i narkoterroryzmu, stając się zagrożeniem międzynarodowym.

Legia Cudzoziemska RACS (Oddział Francuski)
Dowództwo rozmieściło francuską gałąź Legii Cudzoziemskiej RACS, aby rozbić kartel i zlikwidować jego bossów.
Key.Russian:
1. Глобальный контекст (Война с мафией Таноа)

Архипелаг Таноа захвачен хорошо вооруженным мафиозным и наркотеррористическим синдикатом, ставшим международной угрозой.

Иностранный легион RACS (Французское отделение)
Командование направило французское отделение Иностранного легиона RACS для разгрома наркокартеля и ликвидации его главарей.
Key.Turkish:
1. Küresel Bağlam (Tanoa Mafyasına Karşı Savaş)

Tanoa takımadaları, ağır silahlı bir mafya ve narko-terör örgütünün kontrolüne geçerek uluslararası bir tehlike haline gelmiştir.

RACS Yabancı Lejyonu (Fransız Kolu)
Komutanlık, karteli çökertmek ve elebaşlarını etkisiz hale getirmek için RACS Yabancı Lejyonu'nun Fransız kolunu konuşlandırmıştır.
Key.Japanese:
1. グローバルな背景（タノア・マフィアとの戦い）

タノア諸島は重武装した麻薬テロ・マフィア組織に支配され、国際的な重大脅威へと激化しました。

RACS外人部隊（フランス部隊）
連合司令部はカルテルを解体し首領を排除するため、RACS外人部隊フランス分隊を派遣しました。
Key.Korean:
1. 글로벌 배경 (타노아 마피아와의 전쟁)

타노아 군도는 중무장한 마피아 및 마약 테러 조직의 손에 넘어가 심각한 국제적 위험이 되었습니다.

RACS 외인부대 (프랑스 지부)
사령부는 카르텔을 격멸하고 거물급 수괴들을 제거하기 위해 RACS 외인부대 프랑스 부대를 전격 파견했습니다.
Key.Chinese:
1. 全球背景（对塔诺阿黑手党的战争）

塔诺阿群岛已被全副武装的黑手党毒品恐怖集团所控制，成为全球安全的重大国际危险。

RACS 外籍军团（法国分队）
盟军指挥部已部署RACS 外籍军团法国分队，旨在彻底粉碎该犯罪集团并消灭其头目。

Key.Japanese: 2. 任務権限および作戦指示

Key.Original:
2. Objectives and Mandate of the Foreign Legion

The French branch of the RACS Foreign Legion operates under a direct mandate to eradicate the Tanoa mafia and protect the islanders.

Priority Missions
- Logistical Dismantlement: Destroy refining labs, clandestine radio relays, and neutralize heavy armed technicals.
- Neutralization of Kingpins: Eliminate or capture high-value drug lords (HVT) and seize secret cartel financial ledgers.
- Rescue of Infiltrated Agents: Rapidly extract captured undercover intelligence agents before they are executed by hitmen.

Civilian Protection
- Zero civilian casualties tolerated among local islanders.
- Prevent any collateral damage that could bolster cartel influence.
Key.French:
2. Objectifs et Mandat de la Légion Étrangère

La branche française de la Légion Étrangère du RACS est investie d'un mandat direct pour éradiquer la mafia de Tanoa et protéger les populations insulaires.

Missions Prioritaires
- Démantèlement Logistique : Détruire les laboratoires de raffinage, les relais radio de contrebande et neutraliser les pickups armés lourds (technicals).
- Neutralisation des Têtes de Réseau : Éliminer ou capturer les barons de la drogue (HVT) et saisir leurs registres de comptabilité secrète.
- Sauvetage d'Agents Infiltrés : Exfiltrer d'urgence les officiers de renseignement capturés avant leur exécution par les sicarios.

Protection des Civils
- Zéro perte civile tolérée parmi les villageois de l'archipel.
- Éviter tout dommage collatéral susceptible de nourrir l'influence du cartel.

Key.Turkish:

RACS Yabancı Lejyonu Fransız kolu Tanoa mafyasını ortadan kaldırmakla görevlendirilmiştir:

- Sivilleri kesin olarak koruma.

Key.Japanese: 3. 地下ネットワークと国際的脅威

Key.Original:
3. Narrative Context (International Threat)

The Tanoa mafia has expanded far beyond the archipelago: it now operates as a transnational criminal syndicate funding terrorism and destabilizing maritime corridors across the Indian and Pacific Oceans.

Equipped with sophisticated military hardware (Tempest electronic jammers, heavy anti-aircraft technicals, stealth speedboats), this cartel relies on corrupt international mercenary networks.

The surgical strike conducted by the French branch of the RACS Foreign Legion is a vital imperative to crush this threat before it engulfs the entire region.
Key.French:
3. Contexte Narratif (Danger International)

La mafia de Tanoa a étendu son emprise bien au-delà de l'archipel : elle constitue désormais une organisation criminelle transnationale finançant le terrorisme et déstabilisant les corridors maritimes de l'Océan Indien et du Pacifique.

Équipé de matériel militaire sophistiqué (brouilleurs électroniques Tempest, pickups bitubes lourds, vedettes rapides furtives), ce cartel bénéficie de complicités mercenaires internationales.

La frappe chirurgicale menée par la branche française de la Légion Étrangère du RACS a pour impératif de briser cette menace avant qu'elle n'embrase toute la région.
Key.English:
3. Narrative Context (International Threat)

The Tanoa mafia has expanded far beyond the archipelago: it now operates as a transnational criminal syndicate funding terrorism and destabilizing maritime corridors across the Indian and Pacific Oceans.

Equipped with sophisticated military hardware (Tempest electronic jammers, heavy anti-aircraft technicals, stealth speedboats), this cartel relies on corrupt international mercenary networks.

The surgical strike conducted by the French branch of the RACS Foreign Legion is a vital imperative to crush this threat before it engulfs the entire region.
Key.Spanish:
3. Contexto Narrativo (Amenaza Internacional)

La mafia de Tanoa se ha expandido a nivel transnacional y representa una amenaza internacional directa. Equipada con armas pesadas y tecnología de interferencia militar, la intervención de la rama francesa de la Legión Extranjera RACS es esencial para neutralizarla.
Key.Italian:
3. Contesto Narrativo (Minaccia Internazionale)

La mafia di Tanoa costituisce una pericolosa organizzazione transnazionale armata fino ai denti. La frazione francese della Legione Straniera RACS è dispiegata per sradicare questo pericolo globale.
Key.German:
3. Erzählerischer Kontext (Internationale Bedrohung)

Die Tanoa-Mafia agiert als globales Kartell mit schwerem Kriegsgerät. Der französische Zweig der RACS-Fremdenlegion führt gezielte Schläge, um diese Bedrohung zu beseitigen.
Key.Polish:
3. Kontekst Fabularny (Zagrożenie Międzynarodowe)

Mafia Tanoa stała się syndykatem transnarodowym zasilanym sprzętem wojskowym. Francuski oddział Legii RACS musi zlikwidować tę globalną groźbę.
Key.Russian:
3. Сюжетный контекст (Международная угроза)

Мафия Таноа превратилась в транснациональный синдикат, дестабилизирующий морские пути. Удар французского отделения Легиона RACS призван уничтожить эту угрозу.
Key.Turkish:
3. Hikaye Bağlamı (Uluslararası Tehdit)

Tanoa mafyası uluslararası bir tehdit teşkil etmektedir. RACS Yabancı Lejyonu Fransız kolu bu organize suç ağını ortadan kaldırmak için operasyon yürütmektedir.
Key.Japanese:
3. 物語の背景（国際的脅威）

タノア・マフィアは国際的犯罪シンジケートへと拡大し、重大な脅威となっています。RACSフランス外人部隊の外科手術的打撃により壊滅を図ります。
Key.Korean:

타노아 마피아는 초국가적 범죄 네트워크로 진화하여 국제 안보를 위협하고 있습니다. RACS 프랑스 외인부대가 이 위험을 분쇄하기 위해 투입되었습니다.
Key.Chinese:
3. 叙事背景（国际威胁）

塔诺阿黑手党已演变成跨国犯罪组织，对国际海运与安全造成严重威胁。RACS 法国外籍军团展开精确打击以瓦解该武装威胁。
